**Downloads:** `DiskAnalyzer-Setup-x64.msi` (installer) or `DiskAnalyzer-portable-x64.zip` (no install). Windows 10/11, 64-bit; the .NET runtime is included. Verify downloads with `SHA256SUMS.txt`.
Uninstall the MSI from **Settings → Apps**; the portable build can simply be deleted.

**Code signing policy:** Free code signing provided by [SignPath.io](https://about.signpath.io), certificate by [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org). Only binaries built by GitHub Actions from this repository's source are signed. Committers, reviewers and approvers: [Bhanuprasad Thandra](https://github.com/tinkubhanu216). See the [full policy](https://github.com/tinkubhanu216/disk-analyzer#code-signing-policy).

**Privacy policy:** This program will not transfer any information to other networked systems unless specifically requested by the user or the person installing or operating it.
